integrity: The proof derives the result from the complete-multipartite geodesic structure. The checker independently recomputes shortest-path visibility by breadth-first search and exhaustively tests subsets and set partitions in the stated finite range.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs and the dual mutual-visibility variant.
The finite checker covers orders two through eight and is corroborative; the theorem is proved analytically for arbitrary positive part sizes.

The star-infinity boundary is already implied by a general convex-star obstruction in the initiating 2026 paper; the new content is the arbitrary complete-multipartite set characterization, exact polynomial, and complete coloring classification.
title: Dual mutual-visibility profiles of complete multipartite graphs
